mapper.sql: task.production_task_id, task.performance_project_id, task.team_id, task.title, task.description, task.start_date, task.due_date, task.status_code, task.blocked_reason, task.created_by_member_id, task.updated_by_member_id, task.created_dttm, task.updated_dttm, task.deleted_dttm
task.deleted_dttm IS NULL AND project.deleted_dttm IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT FROM production_task task JOIN performance_project project ON project.performance_project_id = task.performance_project_id WHERE task.production_task_id = #{productionTaskId} AND FOR UPDATE

SELECT NULL AS team_id, NULL AS team_name, COUNT(task.production_task_id) AS total_count, COALESCE(SUM(task.status_code = 'COMPLETED'), 0) AS completed_count, COALESCE(SUM(task.status_code = 'BLOCKED'), 0) AS blocked_count, COALESCE(SUM(task.due_date < #{currentDate} AND task.status_code <> 'COMPLETED'), 0) AS overdue_count FROM production_task task JOIN performance_project project ON project.performance_project_id = task.performance_project_id WHERE task.performance_project_id = #{performanceProjectId} AND

SELECT task.team_id, team.name AS team_name, COUNT(*) AS total_count, COALESCE(SUM(task.status_code = 'COMPLETED'), 0) AS completed_count, COALESCE(SUM(task.status_code = 'BLOCKED'), 0) AS blocked_count, COALESCE(SUM(task.due_date < #{currentDate} AND task.status_code <> 'COMPLETED'), 0) AS overdue_count FROM production_task task JOIN performance_project project ON project.performance_project_id = task.performance_project_id JOIN team ON team.team_id = task.team_id WHERE task.performance_project_id = #{performanceProjectId} AND GROUP BY task.team_id, team.name, team.display_order ORDER BY team.display_order

SELECT history.production_task_history_id, history.previous_status_code, history.new_status_code, history.comment, history.changed_by_member_id, member.name AS changed_by_name, history.changed_dttm FROM production_task_history history JOIN production_task task ON task.production_task_id = history.production_task_id JOIN performance_project project ON project.performance_project_id = task.performance_project_id JOIN member ON member.member_id = history.changed_by_member_id WHERE history.production_task_id = #{productionTaskId} AND ORDER BY history.changed_dttm DESC, history.production_task_history_id DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE production_task SET title = #{title}, description = #{description}, start_date = #{startDate}, due_date = #{dueDate}, status_code = #{status}, blocked_reason = #{blockedReason}, updated_by_member_id = #{updatedByMemberId} WHERE production_task_id = #{productionTaskId} AND deleted_dttm IS NULL
